title: MissionDefaultOverridesContract
description: GET /api/v1/admin/mission-default-overrides (administrator): for every zone rule key with a schema default, how many missions' current versions override it and with which values. The root is the report.

MissionDefaultOverrideReport.description: One row per default-bearing rule key, in schema order, and when the report was computed.

MissionDefaultOverride.description: missions_total counts missions whose current version has zones; missions_overriding those with a zone setting the key to a value other than default_value; override_fraction is their ratio (0 without missions); histogram counts missions per set value, most frequent first.

MissionDefaultValueBucket.description: One value missions set for the key, and how many missions set it.
